What is the molality of Na at exchange 1 at transport step 6?

A. 9.895e-04
B. 9.889e-04
C. 9.890e-04
D. 9.893e-04

Use tools as needed for PHREEQC / quantitative work.

tool_calls.name: write_file
tool_calls.arguments:
{"path": "transport.pqi", "new_content": "TITLE 1D transport with exchange

# Initial solution (cells 1-10)
SOLUTION 1-10
    pH    7.0
    Ca    1.0
    Cl    2.0

# Infilling solution (solution 0)
SOLUTION 0
    pH    7.0
    Na    1.0
    Cl    1.0

# Exchange sites for all 10 cells, equilibrated with solution 1
EXCHANGE 1-10
    X    0.001
    -equilibrate 1

SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -file result.out
    -reset false

USER_PUNCH
    -headings step cell Na_X
    -start
    10 PUNCH STEP_NO
    20 PUNCH CELL_NO
    30 PUNCH MOL("NaX")
    -end

TRANSPORT
    -cells          10
    -shifts         10
    -lengths        1.0
    -dispersivities 0.0
    -time_step      1.0
    -boundary_conditions flux flux
    -diffusion_coefficient 0.0
    -punch_cells    1
    -punch_frequency 1

END
"}
